newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc gains from dollar retreat.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc gains from dollar retreat.

text.p: 1620 GMT - The Swiss franc gained ground in Friday trading in the wake of the dollar weakness sparked by profit-taking and concerns about possible intervention, foreign exchange dealers said.
The dollar/Swiss rate of 1.4035/50 is the next important level, and if this holds it could mark the end of this correction, one technical analyst said.
But if this barrier breaks then 1.4020/30, followed by 1.3900, would be the next key support areas, one analyst said.
The mark was likely to find support at the 86.25 centime level, but if this breaks then 86.05, followed by 85.65 are the next key levels to watch, he added.

Separately, Credit Suisse First Boston said in its trading stragety bulletin that mark/Swiss should finish its brief correction today, then head toward a successful attack of the 87.30/40 resistance zone. * Dollar closes at 1.4058/4072 francs vs 1.4240/4250 close. * Mark ends at 86.34/35 centimes vs 86.90/92 * Three-month eurofrancs 1.56/1.81 pct -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
